quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics IR presentation: MOPS 130320261022E001 (10-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 3Q26 results deck (unaudited): consolidated revenue NT$95.60 billion (2Q26 NT$83.65 billion; 3Q25 NT$64.18 billion), operating profit NT$18.31 billion (2Q26 NT$11.36 billion), pre-tax income NT$47.22 billion (2Q26 NT$30.76 billion) and EPS NT$4.90, a single-quarter record (2Q26 NT$3.37); 1Q-3Q26 revenue NT$247.84 billion (1Q-3Q25 NT$195.45 billion), operating profit NT$33.41 billion and record EPS NT$10.07. Electronics rose to 58.1% of 3Q26 sales (46.6% in 3Q25, 52.6% in 2Q26). Electronic materials operating profit rose 96.1% QoQ to a 30.9% operating margin (19.9% in 2Q26, 3.8% in 3Q25); electronic material products added NT$8.42 billion of operating profit QoQ. Equity income rose NT$10.32 billion QoQ, including Nanya Tech +NT$9.92 billion as memory prices kept rising.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics IR presentation: MOPS 130320261022E001 (10-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronic materials supply (3Q26 deck): with AI hyperscale build-out, materials demand surged and prices rose month after month; Nan Ya says capacity utilization across its electronic materials product lines 'is approaching full load' and it is shifting capacity toward high-end materials; equipment suppliers also face shortages, widening the supply gap. PCB-related materials are moving to higher layer counts and more complex formulations. Nan Ya says it has developed Low Dk and Low CTE glass fibers, HVLP copper foils, proprietary hydrocarbon resins and ultra-low-loss CCL, accelerating qualification and mass production of mid-to-high-end products.
quarterly_data.figure: electronic materials utilization approaching full load

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics IR presentation: MOPS 130320261022E001 (10-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 4Q26 outlook (deck): after record performance in the first nine months, 4Q consolidated revenue 'is poised to climb further', driven mainly by electronic materials, and overall performance 'will outpace 3Q'; chemicals and polyesters face short-term ordering with no noticeable downstream recovery, polyester films benefit from AI server and electronics demand, and plastics see higher building-material consumption.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nan Ya Plastics IR presentation: MOPS 130320261022E001 (10-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronic materials (4Q26 outlook slide): besides optimizing and restarting production lines to quickly boost output, Nan Ya says its high-end materials 'will enter a phase of concurrent shipments and qualifications starting in 4Q', driving sustained electronic-materials revenue growth.
